name: manual_681ae0
claim: This machine's OpenClaw launchd label is ai.openclaw.gateway (not com.openclaw.gateway as some skill docs assume) on port 18789 (not 7331), and exposes a WebSocket gateway (ws://) not a plain HTTP /health route — curl to /health will always fail there. Use 'openclaw status' or 'openclaw gateway probe' to check liveness, not curl.
conditions: openclaw restart launchd label port health gateway

decisions.notes: openclaw-restart skill defaults (com.openclaw.gateway, :7331, curl /health) don't match this machine's actual deployment. Verified actual label via launchctl list | grep openclaw and actual port via openclaw status output.
